glance-catalog-001

GitHub Project Glue for fd

This folder is where fd tells GitHub how to behave: how contributors should report bugs or ask questions, how the code gets built and tested on every platform, and how new dependency updates get proposed automatically. None of this code ships to users, but it keeps the project healthy and moving.

1 fileSponsorship config
cargo + actionsDependency bots
4 filesIssue templates
1 workflowCI/CD pipelines

How the pieces cooperate

Two local files handle bookkeeping that has nothing to do with code review. One declares who receives sponsorship links on the repository's GitHub page, listing the maintainers who accept funding.github: [sharkdp, tavianator]

The other configures Dependabot to open pull requests automatically: monthly for Cargo dependencies and daily for GitHub Actions versions, each with a seven-day cooldown before a new release is proposed.package-ecosystem: "cargo" ... interval: "monthly"

The two child directories cover the human and machine sides of contribution. The ISSUE_TEMPLATE directory shapes what a person sees when filing a bug report, feature request, or question, so maintainers get consistent information up front. The workflows directory defines the CICD pipeline that actually builds, lints, and tests fd across fourteen target platforms whenever code changes, and packages releases when a tag is pushed.

Seams and sharp edges

Dependabot cadence is deliberate

Cargo updates are checked monthly and GitHub Actions updates daily, each waiting seven days before being proposed. Changing these intervals changes how quickly the project reacts to upstream releases.

Silent breakage across the two child directories

A stale issue template misleads contributors and slows triage, while an unmaintained build matrix in the workflows can fail silently when a new target is added without updating its prerequisites. Both failures are easy to miss because they only surface when someone files an issue or a release build breaks.

More on the two child directories

Issue templates set the first impression

The bug report template is a structured YAML form asking for the fd version, operating system, and expected versus actual behavior, while feature request and question templates are plain markdown files. A configuration file also allows contributors to open a blank issue without any template.

The CI/CD pipeline enforces cross-platform correctness

The workflow runs on every push, pull request, and tag: it checks formatting and lints, then builds and tests across fourteen target triples covering Linux, macOS, and Windows.CICD workflow

A dedicated job also verifies the crate builds and passes tests on the minimum supported Rust version, guarding against accidental use of newer language features.min_version job
